mapper.sql: FROM srv_inspection_detection_result r JOIN srv_inspection_task t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND t.id = r.task_id AND t.deleted = b'0' JOIN srv_inspection_task_device d ON d.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND d.task_id = r.task_id AND d.device_id = r.device_id AND d.deleted = b'0' JOIN srv_inspection_rule_revision v ON v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.id = r.rule_revision_id AND v.deleted = b'0' JOIN srv_inspection_rule i ON i.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND i.id = v.rule_id AND i.deleted = b'0'

(t.current_report_id = a.report_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM srv_inspection_annotation a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND a2.report_id = a.report_id AND a2.result_id = a.result_id AND a2.deleted = b'0' AND a2.revision_no > a.revision_no AND a2.annotated_at <= #{query.dataAsOf}))

a.id AS annotation_id,a.task_id,t.project_id,a.result_id,a.revision_no AS annotation_revision,a.reason,a.annotated_by,a.annotated_at, r.rule_revision_id,r.create_time AS detected_at,v.rule_id,v.revision_no,i.detection_id,v.inspection_item, v.category_code,v.category_name_snapshot AS category_name,v.severity_code,v.severity_name_snapshot AS severity_name,t.task_code, d.serial_number AS device_serial,d.product_model,r.output_summary, NULL AS device_serial,NULL AS product_model,NULL AS output_summary, f.id AS confirmation_id,COALESCE(f.revision_no,0) AS confirmation_version,f.valid_flag,f.reason AS confirmation_reason,f.confirmed_by,f.confirmed_at, AS active_flag
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset},#{query.pageSize}
SELECT WHERE ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 10001

SELECT r.rule_revision_id,v.rule_id,v.revision_no,i.detection_id,v.inspection_item, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS detection_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.valid_flag = b'1' THEN r.id END) AS confirmed_false_positive_count
LEFT JOIN srv_inspection_annotation a ON a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.result_id = r.id AND a.report_id = t.current_report_id AND a.deleted = b'0' AND a.kind = 'FALSE_POSITIVE' AND a.annotated_at <= #{query.dataAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM srv_inspection_annotation a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND a2.report_id = a.report_id AND a2.result_id = a.result_id AND a2.deleted = b'0' AND a2.revision_no > a.revision_no AND a2.annotated_at <= #{query.dataAsOf}) LEFT JOIN srv_inspection_feedback_confirmation f ON f.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND f.annotation_id = a.id AND f.deleted = b'0' AND f.confirmed_at <= #{query.dataAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM srv_inspection_feedback_confirmation f2 WHERE f2.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND f2.annotation_id = f.annotation_id AND f2.deleted = b'0' AND f2.revision_no > f.revision_no AND f2.confirmed_at <= #{query.dataAsOf}) WHERE AND #{query.administrator} = TRUE GROUP BY r.rule_revision_id,v.rule_id,v.revision_no,i.detection_id,v.inspection_item ORDER BY i.detection_id,v.revision_no
